statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail eases from 20 to 17 because the specific structure that raised it an hour ago has reversed. NQ has retraced 80.50 points off the 29,333.25 session low to 29,413.75, down 125.00 points or 0.42% on the 29,538.75 settle, which is a genuine pullback rather than a third consecutive lower low. VIX at 16.18 sits below its 16.56 session high, the 10-year at 4.808% is flat on the day and below its 4.818% high, and Brent at $100.66 trades under its $100.96 high. Stress stays extreme at 80 because the energy-inflation and yield backdrop is fully intact, but tail returns below the watch band.
recommendation: Tail at 17 maps to EA_ON for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD, and remains well below the block threshold. The narrow evidence-based danger window stays at 13:30-15:00 UTC and is now active: the U.S. cash session opened at 13:30 UTC and that opening auction is not yet observed, which is why the conditional forecast holds tail in the watch band at 21 and 20 across the 14:00 and 15:00 UTC hours before easing again. A secondary checkpoint sits at 17:00 UTC, where the 10-year note auction into a yield near 4.81% coincides with the Apple product keynote. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by the mapped state.
headline: NQ retraces 80 points off the 29,333.25 low to 29,413.75, -0.42%, with VIX and the 10-year both back below their session highs; tail eases from 20 to 17 as the cash session opens
body:
The reading that lifted tail to 20 an hour ago rested on two consecutive hours of lower lows into an unopened cash session, with NQ pinned about 29 points above a 29,333.25 low. That structure has now failed. NQ trades at 29,413.75, some 80.50 points above the low and about 27% of the way up a 29,333.25 to 29,633.75 day range, on a 29,538.75 settle. Investing.com corroborates the same picture at 29,412.75 against an identical previous close and a 29,333.00 low. A retracement of that size is exactly the behaviour whose absence had been the tail argument, so tail steps back from 20 to 17 and the mapped state returns from WATCH to EA_ON.

The cross-asset alignment has loosened rather than hardened. VIX at 16.18 is up 2.93% on the day but is printing below its 16.56 session high rather than at it. The 10-year at 4.808% is essentially unchanged against a 4.806% previous close and sits below its 4.818% session high, so the yield leg that had been extending is now flat. Brent at $100.66 and WTI at $95.71 are both up close to 3% but both trade under their session highs of $100.96 and $96.05. Energy remains the dominant macro channel, and it is why stress stays extreme at 80 rather than falling with tail: Brent above $100 for the first time in two months feeds directly into the producer and consumer price prints scheduled for the next two days.

Constituent behaviour also argues against a clean one-way index path. Delayed latest-session context shows megacap dispersion at 2.10 percentage points, with Meta up 5.17% after its autonomous AI agent launch against Alphabet down 2.25% and Amazon down 1.42%. Semiconductors are uniformly but modestly lower, none positive across seven names with a mean of -0.69%. That combination, a heavy but shallow tech tape with one large megacap moving hard the other way, is more consistent with rotation than with the persistent directional efficiency that overwhelms mean reversion. This context is delayed and is used only as confirmation alongside current quotes, not as live price-path evidence.

The dominant mode moves from trend-down to mixed on the same basis. The day is still negative and the session low is still the reference level, but the price path now includes a working retracement, decaying implied volatility off the high and a stalled yield leg. The one genuine unknown is the opening auction itself, which began at 13:30 UTC and is not yet observed at this cutoff. That is held in the conditional forecast rather than in the current score: the 14:00 UTC slot carries 21 and the 15:00 UTC slot 20, both in the watch band, before the path eases back through the afternoon. Confidence stays at 87 on two corroborating current quotes for NQ plus verified VIX, yield, crude and calendar levels, with the unobserved cash open as the single acknowledged gap.

lookbackSummary: Across the 24 clock-hours from 13:00 UTC on 8 September to 12:00 UTC on 9 September the mapped state was EA_ON in every published hour except the last, which was WATCH. Tail ran between 5 and 20. It sat between 5 and 9 for twenty of the hours, printed 15 twice, at 14:00 UTC on 8 September during a brief trend-down phase in the first full U.S. cash hour and at 11:00 UTC on 9 September when the overnight band broke, and reached 20 in the final hour when the session low extended to 29,333.25. One hour, 10:00 UTC on 9 September, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable. The clearest trend in the window is stress, which climbed almost without interruption from 68 at 17:00 UTC on 8 September to 83 in the final hour as crude advanced through $99 and then above $100 and the 10-year reached its highest level since October 2023. Dominant mode was mixed in nineteen hours, normal in one and trend-down in three, all three of the trend-down hours clustering around cash-session transitions. Confidence held in a tight 86 to 89 band throughout, so the escalation was in the environment rather than in evidence quality.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours contain one high-impact U.S. release cluster: August PPI and Core PPI together with initial jobless claims at 12:30 UTC on 10 September, which falls inside the final forecast slot. CPI on 11 September and the 16 September FOMC decision sit outside the window. Conditional tail runs in an 9-21 band and never approaches the block threshold. It peaks at 21 in the first full U.S. cash hour inside the 13:30-15:00 UTC danger window, where an opening auction meeting a twice-broken overnight range is the specific failure mode of concern, and holds 20 in the hour after that. Those two slots are the only ones mapped to the watch band; every other slot maps to EA_ON. A secondary step to 18 sits at 17:00 UTC for the 10-year auction and Apple keynote combination, and a final step to 19 at 12:00 UTC on 10 September for the PPI and claims release mechanics. The overnight path between 21:00 UTC and 07:00 UTC carries the lowest readings, 9 to 11, consistent with the equivalent hours of the preceding session. Stress eases only gradually from 80 to a 71 trough in the Asian hours before rebuilding to 82 into the PPI slot, because the energy-inflation channel that is driving it is not resolved by intraday rotation. Confidence decays from 87 to 64 across the horizon in the normal way as the observed evidence base ages.
